key_features: Certified IPX4 Splash Protection: Durable ABS shell protects internal circuitry against rain drizzles, pool splashes, and outdoor humidity.

Dynamic Beat-Sync RGB Lighting: Integrated RGB rhythm lighting pulses along with your music tempo to create a lively visual environment.
Rechargeable 1200mAh Battery: Delivers up to 4 hours of continuous playback time for uninterrupted music enjoyment during outings.
Handy Built-In Carrying Strap: Compact 88x88x191mm dimensions and 483g lightweight frame make it simple to carry anywhere.
